spans.s:
(ञि) त्रिदय r. 1st cl. (दयते)
1 To give.
2 To move.
3 To take.
4 To protect.
5 To hurt or kill.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Compassionate, tender-hearted.
mf. (-यः-या)
Tenderness, compassion, clemency.
E.
दय to preserve, affix अङ्, fem. affix टाप्.

(ऋ) दायृ r. 1st cl. (दायते)
To give.

m. (-यः)
1 Gift, donation.
2 A special gift, as a nuptial present, alms to a student at his initiation, &c.
3 Portion, inheritance.
4 Loss, destruction.
5 Breaking, dividing.
6 A place, a site.
7 Irony.
E.
दा to give, in the passive form, affix ण; that which is given; or दो to cut, &c. that which is divided; or दाय to give, affix अच्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Preserving, protecting.
E.
दय, and शानच् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Kind, showing compassion.
E.
दया, and कर who makes.

m. (-र्च्चः)
A Buddha, a Bauddha saint, or a form of BUDDHA, the founder of the sect.
E.
दया compassion, and कूर्च्च boasting.

mfn. (-त्)
Compassionate.
E.
दया, and कृत् doing.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Compassionate, charitable, kind.
E.
दया, and अन्वित possessed of.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Compassionate, benevolent.
E.
दया, and युक्त joined.

m. (-लः)
The breaking of a bank.

mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु)
Tender, compassionate.
E.
दया compassion, आलुच् affix; also दयालुक.

n. (-त्वं)
Tenderness, compassionateness.
E.
त्व added to the last; with तल् दलालुता.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Merciful, tender.
E.
दया, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Kind, compassionate.
E.
दया, and शील possessed of.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Beloved, dear, desired.
m. (-तः)
1 A husband.
2 A lover.
f. (-ता)
1 A woman.
2 A wife or mistress.
E.
दय to regard tenderly, affix क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Condemned, sentenced.
2 Awarded, adjudged.
3 The person to whom any thing is awarded, &c. see दापित.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Hen-pecked, subject to a wife.
E.
दयिता a wife, and अधीन subject.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Liberal, giving, a donor.
E.
दा to give, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-न्धुः)
A brother.
E.
दाय portion, बन्धु a friend.

m. (-गः)
Partition of heritage, apportioning inheritance, &c.
E.
दाय heritage, and भाग a part or portion.

m. (-गः)
Portioning or portion of inheritance, division of property amongst different heirs.
E.
दाय heritage, and धिभाग a part or portion.

m. (-दः)
1 A son.
2 A kinsman, near or remote.
3 An heir.
f. (-दा-दी)
A daughter, an heiress.
E.
दाय a portion, आङ् prefixed to दा to take, affix क.

m. (-वः)
An heir, a kinsman.

n. (-नं)
Privation, a forfeiture of property.
E.
दाय, and अपवर्त्तन taking away.
